verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state you can 'Access account owners' names and mailing addresses' and 'mitigate fraud by verifying account ownership details,' plus an ownership-refresh webhook event confirms this data can be kept current for ownership matching. Community evidence corroborates real-world use as a fraud/ownership signal for ACH payments. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of contact/phone/email fields beyond name+address, and independent hands-on verification of the exact data schema returned.
